title: Optical Hardware Engineering Technical Leader, Acacia (Hybrid)
locations: Maynard, Massachusetts, United States of America
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Hardware Engineering Technical Leader to drive innovation and leadership in Cisco's hardware portfolio. Lead cross-functional teams, shape technical strategy, and ensure high-quality solutions. Ideal for experienced professionals with deep expertise in hardware engineering and a strong background in technical leadership.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026
Preferred candidates must be able to be onsite in Maynard, MA a minimum of three days per week.
 

Meet the Team

Join our team at Acacia, where we develop advanced optical transceivers for high-speed fiber optic transmission in data centers and telecommunication networks. We're seeking enthusiastic, experienced individuals to work on the forefront of fiber optic technology. You'll be part of the team developing high performance optical transceivers with low power consumption. Collaboration with colleagues from the DSP, SW, HW, PIC teams is key to optimizing performance and power efficiency. You'll contribute to producing high volume, high yield products.

Your Impact

With your expertise in optical transceivers, control algorithms and verification, you help the team to develop the next generation of low-power and high-performance transceivers. Here are some examples of possible topics:

Bring-up and optimization of each new coherent transceiver design, including optimization of operating conditions of optical and electrical components

Provide guidance and test results for the development of the integrated optics, high speed electronics, and DSP to maximize performance and minimize size and power consumption of Cisco’s coherent optical transceivers

Design verification testing (DVT) of coherent transceivers to ensure optical specifications are met over operating conditions (temperature, power levels, etc.)

Development of calibration and test procedures to ensure consistent high transceiver performance over a wide range of operating conditions (temperature, production variation, ageing, power levels, etc.)

Work with the operations team to bring these calibration procedures and production tests into high volume manufacturing in a fast, reliable and cost-effective way

Work with the operations team to maximize the product yield through good calibration and production test procedures

Debug of transceivers, both during bring-up and volume manufacturing
 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree with 12+ years of experience or Master’s degree with 8 years of experience, or PhD with 5 years of related experience

Demonstrated experience with coherent optical communications and DSP optimization

Demonstrated experience with photonics integrated circuits and their controls for coherent optical transmission

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with test automation, ideally with Python

Hands-on experience with high-speed RF electronics and ADC/DAC

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
